purpose: Immutable provenance and security policy lock for the M-007 repository development environment. This is a provenance/policy lock, not a second environment-description protocol; devcontainer.json remains the single portable environment description.

base_image.project_license: MIT (docker-node project and Node.js runtime; Debian base under its component licenses)
contains: yarn 1.22.22 (removed deterministically by the M-007 Dockerfile; unused by VibeFlow)
npm (removed deterministically by the M-007 Dockerfile; unused by VibeFlow)

remediation.purpose: Select/remediate the image per M-007 packet 4.3/8. Trixie is the newest official Debian base for Node 24.19.0 (fixes CVE-2025-8714 in postgresql/libpq 17.10 vs bookworm's vulnerable 15.18). The Dockerfile deterministically removes unused bundled npm and yarn material (filesystem-only; no apt/apk operations, no downloads, no floating references).

features.purpose: Provides python3 (Debian trixie os-provided) required by all repository-owned stdlib validators/tests. Feature release is immutable by digest; install behavior is fixed by that release.

permanently_banned: raw secret material in committed/client-readable configuration
silent expansion without an owning later mission declaration

mounts.purpose: Canonical Dev Containers pattern: named volume shadows the host checkout's node_modules inside the container so pnpm install --frozen-lockfile runs non-interactively against a fresh container-local modules dir (fixes ERR_PNPM_ABORTED_REMOVE_MODULES_DIR_NO_TTY) without mutating the host developer's node_modules. Container-local only; no host credential/docker-socket exposure. The volume root is chowned to the host user by initializeCommand so the non-root container user can write it.

initialize_command.purpose: Host-side (initializeCommand) one-shot: chowns the canonical vibeflow-node-modules volume root to the host user so the non-root container user (uid-aligned to the host by devcontainers/ci / VS Code) can write node_modules. Uses the same digest-pinned trixie base, runs as root only inside that throwaway chown container, mounts no host paths into the dev container, and never touches the host checkout's node_modules.

durable_extension_policy.rule: After M-007 acceptance, a later owning mission may extend the environment (forwarded ports, additional digest-pinned registered features, benign environment metadata, additional mounts, runArgs, service containers, or a different explicit non-root dev user) only by recording an explicit extension entry here owned by the actually active later mission (mission_id, rationale, exact declared values). The canonical node_modules volume and initializeCommand, the digest-pinned trixie base, and the deterministic npm/yarn removal are retained as M-007 baseline. Privileged mode, docker-socket mounts, host networking, Docker-in-Docker, root/absent user fields, and raw secret material remain permanently banned and can never be authorized by a declaration.
